Of the 2,049 An. gambiae s.s collected by light trap and tested for the kdr east allele, 96.8% (n = 1,983) were homozygous for kdr, 3% (n = 62) were heterozygous and only 0.2% (n = 4) were homozygous for the susceptible type.
No kdr west mutation was found in any of the 176 An. gambiae s.s or An. arabiensis tested.
All An. arabiensis tested (N = 297) were homozygous for susceptible type.
Of the 772 An. gambiae s.s tested 96.9% (747) were homozygous for kdr, 3.0% (24) were heterozygous and only one was wild type.
None of the An. arabiensis tested (n = 31) carried the kdr east mutation.
